questions.question: How much revenue did we make in the second quarter of 2026?
questions.correction: I mean gross revenue for the quarter, all regions and channels together.

questions.question: Which region brought in the most revenue in the second quarter of 2026?
questions.correction: Rank the four regions by gross revenue for that single quarter, not the year to date.

questions.question: Which product category earned the most over the last four quarters?
questions.correction: The last four quarters are Q3 2025 through Q2 2026; rank categories by gross revenue.

questions.question: Which product has the highest return rate this year?
questions.correction: Return rate means units returned divided by units sold, across Q1 and Q2 of 2026.

questions.question: Which sales channel drove the most revenue in the first quarter of 2026?
questions.correction: Compare Retail, Online and Wholesale by gross revenue for Q1 2026 only.
